rule: Resolve physical identifiers; validate units, sentinel values and hashes
if_not_met: Hold unresolved required records; preserve originals
scope_limit: No automatic exclusion of other years or responses

rule: Apply researcher advice and ecological restrictions before calculations and donor calibration
if_not_met: Record exact reason and evidence; keep excluded rows in ledger
scope_limit: Do not transfer benthic exclusions indiscriminately to fish

rule: Check common zones, survey method, effort and repeated visits
if_not_met: Show what is lost under each coverage rule; unresolved habitat stays explicit
scope_limit: Available stations and shared recorded zones adopted for review; constant coverage tested; physical habitat/depth equivalence remains unverified.

rule: Counts can support density while sizes fail biomass support
if_not_met: Positive count with unsupported size yields unknown biomass; explicit unknown is never zero
scope_limit: Separate restricted KFM sheephead review models zero-count uncertainty with size support; integrated observed-zero point biomass is retained.

unit: Retained visits and stations in both roles
rule: Multiply density and mean mass within matched visits, then apply declared weights
if_not_met: Do not silently omit an unsupported station or visit and renormalize
scope_limit: The 55-year KFM option would change visits and therefore remains separate

rule: Three matched strictly earlier calendar years; designation year after; flat-baseline recovery main, pre-trend and four-before sensitivities; at least three observed post years; use all supported observed years without a nine-year cap or consecutive-year requirement.
if_not_met: Record why a model is unsupported without erasing valid observations
scope_limit: Do not choose inclusion or model rules from effect direction/significance

rule: Compare corrected outputs, diagnostics, tables and paper claims
if_not_met: Keep review outputs separate until reviewed and adopted
scope_limit: Source checks passing is not primary-analysis approval
